comment: The Python that the installer bundles (scripts/build_installer.py reads this file). The build downloads the
zip only with --download, and refuses it unless its SHA-256 is the one below; a cached copy is checked again
on every build. 3.14 is the line python.org still ships Windows binaries for (3.12.10 and 3.13.17 were the last
of theirs; later 3.12 / 3.13 releases are source-only security releases), so the bundle moved to it in 0.7
(DOC-3). A later 3.14.x needs a new url and sha256 here; another minor version also the pth name, python_version
and abi below, and the binary wheels in requirements.lock replaced.

python.source: python.org's Windows release index https://www.python.org/ftp/python/index-windows.json, entry id pythonembed-3.14-64 (sort-version 3.14.10), read 2026-11-06. python.org also publishes a Sigstore bundle for the file.
